members.name: Klaus Ley, MD
members.bio: Cardiovascular immunology researcher and Founding Co-Director of the Immunology Center of Georgia at Augusta University. His work studies immune responses in atherosclerosis and the potential for immune-directed therapies.

members.bio: Biopharmaceutical entrepreneur, co-founder of Population Health Partners, and founder and former CEO of The Medicines Company.
